messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — billing-metering anomaly detected in eu-west-1. token_count drift +11.8% vs 30m baseline, several overage flags triggered. severity: P1. paging dev-oncall.

devon: ack. I'm on it. pulling recent aggregates now.

elaine: CS seeing 2 tickets and 1 email about unexpected overage notices from eu customers. tagging me on any customer-impact updates.

samir: dash link: https://console.redwood/dash/usage-eu-west spike at 2026-03-20T11:34Z, emitter vs aggregator divergence visible.

devon: running quick query against ledger snapshot: `SELECT region, SUM(tokens_emitted) - SUM(tokens_counted) AS delta FROM billing.usage WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY region;`

devon: result (truncated):
```
region    | delta
--------- | -----
eu-west-1 | 124,812  (+11.6%)
us-east-1 | 2,341    (+0.4%)
```

opsbot: autoscaling: no recent capacity events. no deploys in last 3 hours.

sasha: seeing repeated `emitter:ack-timeout` logs from emitter-ops-xx at 11:33:21 UTC. snippet: `WARN emitter[proto] ack_timeout id=0x3f12; queued=812`

devon: hypothesis: emitter retry storm causing duplicate token emissions -> aggregator double-counts on ingest window edge. starting targeted rate-limiting on emitter group eu-west-1 (temp).

elaine: sending templated note to affected customers: "We're investigating unexpected overage alerts. If you're seeing a recent email please hold — we may issue credits." (CS ticket #5789).

samir: can we flip the ingestion-level dedupe to strict mode as a quick mitigation? impact: small latency increase on ingest path.

devon: executing: `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/ingest/config -d '{"dedupe_mode":"strict","region":"eu-west-1"}'` -> 200 OK. enabling for eu-west-1 only.

opsbot: config change applied, rolling window reconcilers will start reprocessing 30s after flag.

elaine: quick check with CS — ticket owner confirmed overage email stopped arriving after 11:46 UTC.

samir: metrics trending down. delta now ~+1.2% over 10m. looks like mitigation working.

devon: leaving a temporary rule to silence noisy overage alerts for eu-west-1 for 1 hour while we run reconciliation. creating short-lived incident tag: `billing-slow-bloom-1769999995`.

elaine: I'll follow up with customer emails once reconciliation completes and we'll credit any false charges.

devon: post-incident tasks: 1) root-cause triage (emitter retry logic) 2) add unit test for ack dedupe edge-case 3) run full ledger reconcile job and backfill corrected counts. assigning to billing-eng (samir) and emitter team (sasha).

sasha: ack. grabbing logs and will instrument extra metrics for ack latency.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. P1 -> monitoring. will convert to follow-up postmortem ticket. :white_check_mark:
